$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
STRIP='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_minus05_to_plus45_step05.png'
TARGET='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png'
test -f "$STRIP"
test ! -e "$TARGET"
test "$(sha256sum "$STRIP" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'de2026c20b5bb2f53f137024a9ca3ec34cc742a3bc4fafcd92f7eab56d3f5c34'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_center1448_venv
/tmp/fishfry_center1448_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry_center1448_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from PIL import Image
root=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry')
strip=root/'pizza_screen_rotations_minus05_to_plus45_step05.png'
target=root/'pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png'
with Image.open(strip) as im:
    assert im.size==(16896,1476), im.size
    old_minus05=im.crop((0,0,1536,1476)).convert('RGB')
minus01=old_minus05.rotate(1,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
# Pan outer rim center estimated from source at x=777, y=741.
# Crop [53,1501) x [17,1465) -> rim center at canvas (724,724).
left,top=53,17
square=minus01.crop((left,top,left+1448,top+1448))
assert square.size==(1448,1448), square.size
assert square.getpixel((0,0))==(255,255,255)
square.save(target,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
print('INPUT',strip,'SOURCE_DIMS',(1536,1476),flush=True)
print('SELECTED_FRAME','GH old -5 plus 1 degree CCW = new minus01',flush=True)
print('PAN_CENTER_SOURCE',(777,741),'CROP_LEFT_TOP',(left,top),'PAN_CENTER_OUTPUT',(724,724),flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',target,'SIZE',square.size,'BYTES',target.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$TARGET"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Center minus-one-degree fish fry screen in 1448 square'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then
    printf 'COMMITTED '; git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD '; gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    printf 'LOCAL_BLOB '; git hash-object "$TARGET"
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLISH_FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES' >&2
exit 1
